yaml_content:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Salon Booking API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: API for customer registration, browsing salon services, booking and canceling appointments, and processing online payments.
servers:
  - url: https://api.salonbooking.com/v1
    description: Production Server

paths:
  /auth/register:
    post:
      summary: Register a new customer
      description: Creates a new customer account in the salon booking system.
      operationId: registerCustomer
      x-source-requirements:
        - REQ-001
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CustomerRegistrationRequest'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Customer successfully registered
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthResponse'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequestError'
        '409':
          description: Email already in use
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/UnprocessableEntityError'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalServerError'

  /auth/login:
    post:
      summary: Authenticate user
      description: Logs in a customer or staff user and returns an authentication token.
      operationId: loginUser
      x-source-requirements:
        - REQ-001
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/LoginRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Successfully authenticated
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthResponse'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequestError'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/UnauthorizedError'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/UnprocessableEntityError'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalServerError'

  /services:
    get:
      summary: View available salon services
      description: Retrieves a list of available services offered by the salon.
      operationId: getServices
      x-source-requirements:
        - REQ-002
      parameters:
        - name: category
          in: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
          description: Filter services by category (e.g., Haircut, Coloring, Manicure)
        - name: page
          in: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            default: 1
            minimum: 1
          description: Page number for pagination
        - name: limit
          in: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            default: 20
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
          description: Number of items per page
      responses:
        '200':
          description: List of available salon services
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ServiceListResponse'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequestError'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalServerError'

  /services/{serviceId}:
    get:
      summary: Get details of a specific service
      description: Retrieves details of an individual service by ID.
      operationId: getServiceById
      x-source-requirements:
        - REQ-002
      parameters:
        - name: serviceId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
          description: Unique ID of the service
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Service details retrieved successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Service'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequestError'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFoundError'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalServerError'

  /services/{serviceId}/availability:
    get:
      summary: Get available appointment times for a service
      description: Retrieves open time slots that a customer can choose to book a selected service.
      operationId: getServiceAvailability
      x-source-requirements:
        - REQ-002
        - REQ-003
      parameters:
        - name: serviceId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
          description: Unique ID of the service
        - name: date
          in: query
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: date
          description: Target date for appointment slot availability (YYYY-MM-DD)
        - name: staffId
          in: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
          description: Optional filter by specific staff member
      responses:
        '200':
          description: List of available time slots
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AvailabilitySlotsResponse'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequestError'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFoundError'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/UnprocessableEntityError'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalServerError'

  /appointments:
    get:
      summary: List customer appointments
      description: Retrieves appointments for the authenticated customer or all appointments for staff.
      operationId: listAppointments
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      x-source-requirements:
        - REQ-001
        - REQ-003
      parameters:
        - name: status
          in: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [CONFIRMED, CANCELLED, COMPLETED, PENDING_PAYMENT]
          description: Filter appointments by status
      responses:
        '200':
          description: List of appointments
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AppointmentListResponse'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/UnauthorizedError'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalServerError'
    post:
      summary: Book an appointment
      description: Choose an appointment time and service to create a new appointment booking.
      operationId: createAppointment
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      x-source-requirements:
        - REQ-001
        - REQ-003
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateAppointmentRequest'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Appointment successfully created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Appointment'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequestError'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/UnauthorizedError'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFoundError'
        '409':
          description: The selected time slot is no longer available
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/UnprocessableEntityError'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalServerError'

  /appointments/{appointmentId}:
    get:
      summary: Get appointment details
      description: Retrieves details of an existing appointment by ID.
      operationId: getAppointmentById
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      x-source-requirements:
        - REQ-001
        - REQ-003
      parameters:
        - name: appointmentId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
          description: Unique identifier of the appointment
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Appointment details
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Appointment'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/UnauthorizedError'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFoundError'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalServerError'

  /appointments/{appointmentId}/cancel:
    post:
      summary: Cancel an appointment
      description: Allows a customer to cancel an existing appointment.
      operationId: cancelAppointment
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      x-source-requirements:
        - REQ-005
      parameters:
        - name: appointmentId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
          description: Unique identifier of the appointment to cancel
      requestBody:
        required: false
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CancelAppointmentRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Appointment successfully cancelled
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Appointment'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequestError'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/UnauthorizedError'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFoundError'
        '409':
          description: Appointment cannot be cancelled (e.g. already completed or past cancellation window)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalServerError'

  /appointments/{appointmentId}/payments:
    post:
      summary: Pay online for an appointment
      description: Processes an online payment for a booked salon appointment.
      operationId: createPaymentForAppointment
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      x-source-requirements:
        - REQ-004
      parameters:
        - name: appointmentId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
          description: Unique identifier of the appointment being paid for
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/PaymentRequest'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Payment processed successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PaymentResponse'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequestError'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/UnauthorizedError'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFoundError'
        '409':
          description: Appointment already paid or payment conflict
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/UnprocessableEntityError'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalServerError'

components:
  securitySchemes:
    BearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT

  responses:
    BadRequestError:
      description: Bad request - invalid syntax or parameters
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
    UnauthorizedError:
      description: Authentication required or invalid token
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
    NotFoundError:
      description: Resource not found
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
    UnprocessableEntityError:
      description: Validation error in request body
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationErrorResponse'
    InternalServerError:
      description: Unexpected internal server error
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'

  schemas:
    CustomerRegistrationRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - email
        - password
        - phoneNumber
      properties:
        firstName:
          type: string
          example: Jane
        lastName:
          type: string
          example: Doe
        email:
          type: string
          format: email
          example: jane.doe@example.com
        password:
          type: string
          format: password
          minLength: 8
          example: SecureP@ssw0rd!
        phoneNumber:
          type: string
          pattern: '^\+?[1-9]\d{1,14}$'
          example: '+15551234567'

    LoginRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - email
        - password
      properties:
        email:
          type: string
          format: email
          example: jane.doe@example.com
        password:
          type: string
          format: password
          example: SecureP@ssw0rd!

    AuthResponse:
      type: object
      required:
        - tokenType
        - accessToken
        - expiresIn
        - user
      properties:
        tokenType:
          type: string
          example: Bearer
        accessToken:
          type: string
          example: eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...
        expiresIn:
          type: integer
          description: Token validity in seconds
          example: 3600
        user:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/User'

    User:
      type: object
      required:
        - id
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - email
        - role
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          example: a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890
        firstName:
          type: string
          example: Jane
        lastName:
          type: string
          example: Doe
        email:
          type: string
          format: email
          example: jane.doe@example.com
        phoneNumber:
          type: string
          example: '+15551234567'
        role:
          type: string
          enum: [CUSTOMER, STAFF, ADMIN]
          example: CUSTOMER
        createdAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2023-10-01T12:00:00Z'

    Service:
      type: object
      required:
        - id
        - name
        - description
        - durationMinutes
        - price
        - currency
        - isAvailable
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          example: 3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6
        name:
          type: string
          example: Haircut & Styling
        description:
          type: string
          example: Premium haircut including wash, dry, and blow-styling.
        category:
          type: string
          example: Hair
        durationMinutes:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
          example: 60
        price:
          type: number
          format: float
          minimum: 0
          example: 65.00
        currency:
          type: string
          example: USD
        isAvailable:
          type: boolean
          example: true

    ServiceListResponse:
      type: object
      required:
        - items
        - total
        - page
        - limit
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Service'
        total:
          type: integer
          example: 1
        page:
          type: integer
          example: 1
        limit:
          type: integer
          example: 20

    TimeSlot:
      type: object
      required:
        - startTime
        - endTime
        - staffId
        - staffName
        - isAvailable
      properties:
        startTime:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2023-10-15T10:00:00Z'
        endTime:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2023-10-15T11:00:00Z'
        staffId:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          example: 10101010-1010-1010-1010-101010101010
        staffName:
          type: string
          example: Sarah Stylist
        isAvailable:
          type: boolean
          example: true

    AvailabilitySlotsResponse:
      type: object
      required:
        - serviceId
        - date
        - availableSlots
      properties:
        serviceId:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          example: 3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6
        date:
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2023-10-15'
        availableSlots:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/TimeSlot'

    CreateAppointmentRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - serviceId
        - startTime
      properties:
        serviceId:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          example: 3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6
        staffId:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          nullable: true
          example: 10101010-1010-1010-1010-101010101010
        startTime:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2023-10-15T10:00:00Z'
        notes:
          type: string
          maxLength: 500
          example: Please use sensitive skin shampoo.

    CancelAppointmentRequest:
      type: object
      properties:
        cancellationReason:
          type: string
          maxLength: 250
          example: Schedule conflict

    Appointment:
      type: object
      required:
        - id
        - customerId
        - service
        - startTime
        - endTime
        - status
        - paymentStatus
        - totalAmount
        - currency
        - createdAt
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          example: b00c4391-4d32-4752-9bc1-49b422a57ee7
        customerId:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          example: a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890
        service:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Service'
        staffId:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          example: 10101010-1010-1010-1010-101010101010
        staffName:
          type: string
          example: Sarah Stylist
        startTime:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2023-10-15T10:00:00Z'
        endTime:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2023-10-15T11:00:00Z'
        status:
          type: string
          enum: [CONFIRMED, CANCELLED, COMPLETED, PENDING_PAYMENT]
          example: CONFIRMED
        paymentStatus:
          type: string
          enum: [UNPAID, PAID, REFUNDED]
          example: UNPAID
        totalAmount:
          type: number
          format: float
          example: 65.00
        currency:
          type: string
          example: USD
        cancellationReason:
          type: string
          nullable: true
          example: null
        notes:
          type: string
          nullable: true
          example: Please use sensitive skin shampoo.
        createdAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2023-10-10T08:30:00Z'

    AppointmentListResponse:
      type: object
      required:
        - items
        - total
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Appointment'
        total:
          type: integer
          example: 1

    PaymentRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - amount
        - currency
        - paymentMethod
        - paymentMethodToken
      properties:
        amount:
          type: number
          format: float
          minimum: 0.01
          example: 65.00
        currency:
          type: string
          example: USD
        paymentMethod:
          type: string
          enum: [CREDIT_CARD, DEBIT_CARD, PAYPAL]
          example: CREDIT_CARD
        paymentMethodToken:
          type: string
          description: Token generated by the online payment gateway (e.g., Stripe, PayPal)
          example: tok_visa

    PaymentResponse:
      type: object
      required:
        - paymentId
        - appointmentId
        - amount
        - currency
        - status
        - transactionId
        - paidAt
      properties:
        paymentId:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          example: 77777777-8888-9999-aaaa-bbbbccccdddd
        appointmentId:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          example: b00c4391-4d32-4752-9bc1-49b422a57ee7
        amount:
          type: number
          format: float
          example: 65.00
        currency:
          type: string
          example: USD
        status:
          type: string
          enum: [SUCCESSFUL, FAILED, PENDING]
          example: SUCCESSFUL
        transactionId:
          type: string
          example: ch_3MtwBwLkdIwHu7ix28a3tqPa
        paidAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2023-10-10T08:35:00Z'

    ErrorResponse:
      type: object
      required:
        - code
        - message
      properties:
        code:
          type: string
          example: INVALID_INPUT
        message:
          type: string
          example: The requested slot or parameter is invalid.
        details:
          type: string
          example: Additional details explaining the error.

    ValidationErrorResponse:
      type: object
      required:
        - code
        - message
        - errors
      properties:
        code:
          type: string
          example: VALIDATION_FAILED
        message:
          type: string
          example: Validation failed on request parameters or body
        errors:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            required:
              - field
              - message
            properties:
              field:
                type: string
                example: email
              message:
                type: string
                example: Must be a valid email address
